videos.title: Opus 4.7 Just Broke Polymarket (for us little guys)
videos.description:
Most people think trading bots are only for elite coders, hedge funds, or people with fancy degrees. I’ll show you why that isn’t true in my private live stream 👉 https://moondev.com/t/yt/opus47pm

Let’s get something clear right away

This channel is not for people looking to get rich overnight
It’s not plug and play
There are no shortcuts here

If you’re impatient, this probably isn’t for you

And honestly, that’s why most traders lose

Most traders overtrade
They use too much leverage
They smash market orders
They get wrecked on fees
They trade emotionally
They get liquidated

They know trading is the vehicle
They just can’t drive it manually for long without crashing

That’s the problem I care about solving

On this channel, I build algorithmic trading systems live

Sometimes I’m codin
